title: Normalize Writer Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the repo-wide Consistency Contract (Wave 3, mechanical pass): adopt PanelKit (tree_item/PanelTreeBuilder) from semio_framework_plugin for build_document_tree; adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled WriterLabels struct+consts+resolver and writer_action_labels/writer_utility_labels bodies; verify .resource_kind(...) is present; rename WriterApp -> WriterPlayApp (app id "writer-play" matches C1); fix region markers (rename registration region to "🔖️Manifest" if needed, tests region to "🧪️Tests", fix emoji-less/inconsistently-spaced region markers, reorder into canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl(s) -> Manifest -> Tests order); adopt Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/paired_apps/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local scaffolding. Do NOT touch the hand-rolled JackLexer/JackParser/JackAst subsystem (reserved for a separate Wave-3 agent) beyond wrapping it in a DocumentHelpers region marker.
summary: Normalized writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract (mechanical pass, JackLexer/JackParser/JackAst content left untouched per instructions). C1: renamed struct WriterApp -> WriterPlayApp everywhere (impl DocumentApp, VcsDocumentApp<WriterPlayApp>, semio_plugin! apps: entry, all test helpers) — app id "writer-play" string unchanged, zero residue of the old identifier repo-wide (fixtures/manifests had no references to begin with). C2/C3: fixed emoji-less/inconsistently-spaced region markers ("// #region grammar" -> "//#region 🔖️Grammar", same for its endregion); renamed "🔖️Document" -> "🔖️Types"; wrapped the reserved JackAst+JackEditor blocks in a new "🔖️DocumentHelpers" region (JackLexer/JackParser/JackAst region names and bodies left byte-for-byte untouched); renamed "🔖️Scene" -> "🔖️Render"; renamed "🔖️WriterApp" -> "🔖️WriterPlayApp"; registration region was already "🔖️Manifest" and tests region already "🧪️Tests" (no change needed there); reordered top-level regions into canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests order (moved CommandLabels up from after the App impl to right after Terminology). PanelKit adoption: deleted the local empty_tree_item helper (replaced its one call site with the SDK's tree_item) and rewrote render_document_panel's manual UiNode::Tree/UiTreeSectionNode construction on top of PanelTreeBuilder::section_or_placeholder/.selected/.highlighted/.selection_change/.build(); render_catalogue_panel/render_inspection_panel already used the (different, non-PanelKit) ui_declarative_sections_to_tree SDK helper and were left as-is beyond the type rename. Terminology adoption: replaced the hand-rolled WriterLabels struct + WRITER_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + writer_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!{ struct WriterPlayLabels { ... } } + resolve_labels::<WriterPlayLabels>(view_state) at all 4 call sites (render, window_engagements, window_measures, app_labels); writer_action_labels/writer_utility_labels rewritten to call localized_label_map(is_de, ENTRIES) instead of hand-rolled map-building; DocumentApp::app_labels rewritten from a manual AppLabelsOverlay{..} struct literal to the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.panel_tab_label x2/.mode_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels). Testkit adoption: removed the local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() scaffolding in favor of semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, new_app_with_registry} (call sites updated: meta() -> meta("local"), new_app() -> new_app::<WriterPlayApp>(), new_app_with_registry() -> new_app_with_registry::<WriterPlayApp>(create_writer_app)); writer has no two-instance-convergence or ingest-idempotency tests to migrate, and its one undo/redo test (set_text_undo_redo_round_trips_through_the_wrapper) asserts extra invariants (empty ops + a history-changed event) beyond the generic assert_undo_redo_round_trip shape, so per instructions it was left as an app-unique test (only its meta()/new_app() calls updated). C4: verified single-app crate (one impl DocumentApp) — flat layout confirmed correct, no pub mod wrapping needed. Verified .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{ id: "text.document", ... }) was already present on the AppBuilder chain — no change needed. Bug fix found and fixed while retyping the DE label block: the German label constants used ASCII transliterations (Pruefen, Schriftgroesse, Zeilenhoehe, Tabulatorgroesse, "Format, pruefen, ...", plus several ASCII forms in writer_action_labels' German entries) while an existing test (writer_labels_resolve_german_locale) asserts the proper-umlaut forms ("Prüfen", "Schriftgröße") — the constants were corrected to use proper umlauts (Prüfen, Schriftgröße, Zeilenhöhe, Tabulatorgröße, prüfen, übernehmen, bestätigen, Vervollständigungen, auswählen) so the data matches what the pre-existing test expects.
